bihar_raw_news.title: Taruwar Agro: Three Bihar Friends Built a Rs 2.5 Crore Business from Banana Waste
bihar_raw_news.content: I n Bihar's farms, banana plants are often considered useless after they bear fruit. Farmers typically cut down the remaining stems and remove them from their fields, as they have little practical use once the harvest is complete. Advertisement However, three friends saw a business opportunity in what others viewed as agricultural waste. Jagat Kalyan, Satyam Kumar, and Nitish Kumar Verma chose entrepreneurship over conventional career paths and began exploring ways to extract fiber from banana stems. Their goal was not just to create a new product but to build a business around Bihar's locally available resources. This vision led to the launch of Taruwar Agro Industries. Today, the company manufactures a variety of products from banana fiber, including file folders, yoga mats, baskets, and prayer mats. The remaining parts of the banana plant are used to produce vermicompost and plant nutrition liquid, ensuring minimal waste. In FY26, the company recorded revenue of approximately Rs 2.5 crore. The model has created additional income opportunities for farmers, who can now earn from banana plants even after harvesting the fruit. At the same time, the company's processing and manufacturing operations have generated employment opportunities for local communities. Taruwar Agro's journey is more than the story of a startup. It reflects a growing effort to identify business opportunities in Bihar's local resources and create sustainable livelihoods through innovation. From Friendship to Business Partnership The three founders first met while pursuing their MBA. Coming from different parts of Bihar, their friendship gradually evolved into a business partnership. Jagat Kalyan hails from Khagaria and is the only child of his parents. His grandfather was a farmer, while his maternal grandfather worked as a government officer in the agriculture department. His father worked in the banking sector, and his mother is a homemaker. Due to his father's job, the family later moved to Patna. After completing school, Jagat pursued engineering in Bengaluru and later earned an MBA. During his management studies, he interned with companies working in environmental sustainability and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. After graduation, he received job opportunities from organizations in Tanzania, Dubai, and IDFC First Bank. Despite these prospects, he chose a different path. Along with his friends, Jagat decided to build something in Bihar. Speaking to YourStory, Jagat Kalyan, CEO of Taruwar Agro, said: "All three of us had several job opportunities. We even had chances to work abroad. But during the COVID-19 pandemic, we started thinking that if we were going to work hard, why not do it for ourselves? Why not create something for our state and our people? We wanted Bihar to produce something that could earn recognition at both national and global levels." The founders then began researching Bihar's natural resources and the business opportunities associated with them. Nitish Kumar Verma is from Bihar Sharif. He completed his early education in Bokaro before studying commerce in Bihar Sharif. After earning a B.Com (Hons) degree from Nalanda, he pursued an MBA. bihar_raw_news.title: Monolithisch India bags ₹157 crore Bihar quartzite block; targets lower raw material costs
bihar_raw_news.content: Monolithisch India Limited has secured a quartzite stone mining block in Bihar for ₹157 crore, giving the silica ramming mass maker access to up to 35.5 lakh tonnes of approved mining capacity over the next five years. The company said the strategic backward integration is expected to significantly lower raw material procurement costs and strengthen margins as it ramps up manufacturing capacity. The block, located in Nawada district , was secured through an e-auction conducted by the Mines and Geology Department of the Bihar government. It carries an approved mining capacity of 7.10 lakh tonnes per annum , or 35.50 lakh tonnes over the five-year allotment period . The development comes as Monolithisch expands its silica ramming mass business, with consolidated group manufacturing capacity expected to reach 5.76 lakh tonnes per annum . The company said securing a captive source of quartzite will provide greater visibility over raw material availability and prices as the new capacity comes on stream. Captive quartzite to lower procurement costs The quartzite block could yield up to 7.10 lakh tonnes of ore annually , subject to mining and statutory conditions. Monolithisch has not disclosed the expected recovery or beneficiation yield from the mined ore. However, the approved capacity represents a substantial captive raw material base compared with its planned 5.76 lakh tonnes per annum manufacturing capacity. The company expects the integration to reduce raw material procurement costs significantly once mining begins. It also expects to reduce the amount of raw material held at its manufacturing facilities, potentially releasing working capital and reducing its exposure to fluctuations in externally sourced raw material prices. The company said the ore from this block is known for its quality and consistency and has historically been sought after by secondary steel clusters. It expects access to a consistent ore source to improve product quality while supporting the development of new products based on different ore grades. Operations likely from February-March 2027 Commercial mining operations are expected to commence in February-March 2027 , subject to statutory approvals and clearances. The company currently expects the required approvals to be obtained within around three to four months, depending on regulatory processes. Rather than making significant upfront investments in mining infrastructure, Monolithisch plans to outsource mining activities through per-tonne raising contracts to experienced national mining contractors. This approach is expected to limit direct capital expenditure associated with the mining operation. The company will separately establish a beneficiation and storage unit near the block . The facility will be used to process and store the ore, maintain quality consistency and support research and development for new products. ₹157 crore payment spread over five years The ₹157 crore consideration will be paid in multiple tranches over the five-year tenure in accordance with state government guidelines. Monolithisch said it is targeting a 50% reduction in raw material inventory in H2FY27 , with the aim of maintaining a near debt-free balance sheet while meeting the mining-related payment commitments. bihar_raw_news.title: Buxar Thermal Power Project Unit-II gets commissioned - Indian Infrastructure Magazine
bihar_raw_news.content: SJVN Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary SJVN Thermal Private Limited, has achieved commercial operation of the 660 MW Unit-II of its 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar. Located at Chausa in Buxar district, the project comprises two 660 MW units and uses supercritical technology. It has been developed at a total investment of approximately Rs 137.57 billion, revised at the June 2025 price level. The project is expected to generate 9,828.72 million units of electricity annually, of which 85 per cent has been allocated to Bihar under a long-term power purchase agreement. Unit-I of the project had already achieved commercial operation on November 14, 2025. With the commissioning of Unit-II, the entire 1,320 MW capacity has been brough into commercial operation. The project is expected to improve power availability in Bihar and the eastern region, reduce peak-hour shortages and strengthen energy security. It is also SJVN’s first thermal power project to become fully operational.

bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar approves INR 3,516 crore tourism-related projects for Gaya - Travel Trends Today
bihar_raw_news.content: Vishnupad_temple The Vishnupad Temple complex development at INR 2,520 crore aims to modernise facilities and accommodate the large influx of devotees visiting Gaya annually for rituals. Additionally, INR 996.05 crore has been designated for the Son-Falgu River Linking Project. The Bihar Cabinet has approved INR 3,516 crore worth of projects for Gaya, including the Vishnupad Corridor and the Son–Falgu river-link initiative. The development is aimed at improving tourism infrastructure and visitor facilities while strengthening Gaya’s position as one of India’s important religious, spiritual and cultural tourism destinations. Modelled on the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor in Varanasi, the Vishnupad Temple complex development at INR 2,520 crore aims to modernise facilities and accommodate the large influx of devotees visiting Gaya annually for Pind Daan rituals. Also, under the INR 996.05-crore Son-Falgu River Linking Project, an intake well is proposed to be built approximately 23 km upstream from Indrapuri Barrage. The investment could provide a major boost to pilgrimage tourism and the local visitor economy, creating new opportunities for hotels, tour operators, transport providers and other tourism businesses. Improved infrastructure around Gaya is also expected to enhance the overall visitor experience and support the region’s long-term tourism growth. Alongside these approvals given for almost 17 projects, officials endorsed a memorandum of understanding with the Civil Aviation Ministry and Airports Authority of India to expand regional connectivity under the Modified UDAN Scheme and approved the Bihar State Civil Aviation Cadre Recruitment Rules 2026. national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi today inaugurated SEMICON India 2026 at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi. The three-day conference is focusing on advancing collaboration, investment, innovation and talent development in India. Speaking on the occasion, Mr Modi said that on one side India’s economy is growing and the other side, global trust in India is also growing. He said, despite the challenging global environment, India recorded a growth rate of 7.8 per cent. Prime Minister said, at the same time, Japan’s credit rating agency also upgraded India’s sovereign rating. Mr Modi said, every citizen of the country is working with a commitment to build a developed India. Prime Minister said, India’s semiconductor ecosystem is expanding rapidly and it is is opening new opportunities for innovation, investment and growth. Prime Minister Modi said, India is taking every step needed to become a preferred destination for the semiconductor industry. He said, the world is looking for new and trusted manufacturing destinations. Mr Modi said, the chips manufactured in India are now available within the country and around the world. Mr Modi highlighted that recently, commercial production began at two semiconductor plants in Mohali and Surat. He said, it is not easy for any country to reach this stage. Prime Minister Modi said, India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 expanded outlay to 13.5 billion US dollar from eight billion US dollar in the first phase. He highlighted that so far 12 chip making projects have been approved in the next phase it will further increase. In his address, the Prime Minister also mentioned about recently held BRICS Summit in New Delhi. He said, India successfully hosted the summit in which New Delhi Declaration was adopted with consensus of every member country. Mr Modi said, it is another major testament to the world’s trust in India. On the occasion, Union Minister of Electronics and IT Ashwini Vaishnaw said that India had wanted to establish a semiconductor industry for several decades, but it was possible only under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He said, the foundation has now been laid and the next step is to build the industry through Semicon 2.0, which focuses on six major pillars. This include semiconductor design, machines and materials, memory, silicon, compound and logic fabrication units and research and development. He said, the government has set a target to support at least 200 startups and companies to design chips in India across the spectrum of semiconductor requirements. The SEMICON India 2026 event has brought together over 600 exhibitors, 300 international companies, and delegations from more than 50 countries. The exhibition features six country pavilions representing Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, Netherlands, Singapore and Sweden, twelve State Government pavilions, and a dedicated Startup Pavilion. The conference and exhibition, being held from today is being organised on the theme Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem. It has brought together global and Indian companies, policymakers, investors, researchers, start-ups, academic institutions and students from across the semiconductor and electronics value chain.

national_raw_news.title: 7 hours ago | International 179 US Federal Reserve raises interest rates for first time in three years
national_raw_news.content: The Federal Reserve in United States raised its benchmark interest rate for the first time since 2023 in an effort to lower persistent high inflation. The central bank also signalled that another rate hike could occur later this year. The quarter-point increase lifts the Fed’s key rate to about 3.9 percent and, over time, could result in higher borrowing costs for mortgages, auto loans, and credit cards. In a set of quarterly projections, the Fed also signalled that its rate-setting committee expects to hike rates a second time to 4.1 per cent. The move comes as Americans are already struggling with high costs for groceries, gas, and housing. Affordability has taken on a leading role in the upcoming midterm elections, just seven weeks away. In a press conference following the Fed’s announcement, Chair of Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh emphasised that the economy has shown signs of gathering speed since the central bank decided to keep rates unchanged in late July. Inflation has also remained stubbornly above the Fed’s 2 per cent target and he noted that there is little sign it is cooling. Warsh also said renewed combat between the US and Iran, which has driven up gas prices, also convinced Fed officials to support rate hikes. According to the Fed’s preferred measure, inflation was 3.7 per cent in July this year compared with a year ago, up from 2.3 per cent in April last year, just before Trump unveiled sweeping tariffs. US President Donald Trump has called for sharply lower interest rates following Fed’s decision. In a post on Truth Social, Trump asserted that US interest rates should be 1 per cent, or less, maintaining that the nation warrants cheaper credit. Trump also associated his demands for monetary relaxation with the national trade balance, asserting that the country could accumulate a minimum of 1.5 trillion dollars annually by halting commerce with states generating a trade deficit.

national_raw_news.title: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan leads Hyderabad Liberation Day commemoration in Secunderabad 15 mins ago 3
national_raw_news.content: The Ministry of Culture officially commemorated Hyderabad Liberation Day at the Parade Grounds in Secunderabad today, marking the 79th anniversary of the erstwhile princely state’s integration into the Indian Union following Operation Polo on September 17, 1948. The event commenced with Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan, accompanied by Union Minister G Kishan Reddy, paying homage to fallen soldiers at the War Memorial. Addressing the gathering, Vice President highlighted that September 17, 1948, marked the conclusion of a decisive chapter in independent India’s history. He described the integration as a reflection of statesmanship, courage, and sacrifice, noting that the story of Hyderabad illustrates the enormous challenges faced by a young nation consolidating diverse territories into a constitutional democracy. He paid rich tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel for laying the foundation of a unified nation, while also acknowledging the sacrifices of freedom fighters such as Ramji Gond, Turrebaz Khan, and Komaram Bheem. He emphasised that national unity extends beyond geography and relies on equal rights, dignity, and opportunity for every citizen. Additionally, he praised the Central Armed Police Forces for their historic role during the state’s integration and their ongoing efforts against Left-Wing Extremism. Telangana Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla noted that the liberation of Hyderabad stands as a crucial milestone coming thirteen months after national independence, attributing the final integration to Sardar Patel’s determination and the courage of freedom fighters. Union Culture Minister G Kishan Reddy pointed out that this event marks the fifth consecutive year the Ministry of Culture has hosted the official commemoration to honour the true aspirations of the region. He criticised attempts to erase the history of the movement, reiterating the government’s resolve to preserve the accurate history of the liberation struggle. Meanwhile, Union Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat framed Operation Polo as a decisive victory of righteousness over oppression, reflecting the triumph of collective national resolve. Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar spoke on the sacrifices made by the public against the oppressive Nizam regime and the Razakars, emphasising that the central government remains dedicated to keeping this historical legacy alive. At the event, Mr. Radhakrishnan also visited a two-day photo exhibition organised by the Central Bureau of Communication under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. The exhibition documented the struggle, sacrifices, and historic journey toward Hyderabad’s integration, with the Vice President commending its extensive research and design.

national_raw_news.title: Army Chief Gen Dhiraj Seth holds bilateral talks with top Russian commanders in Moscow
national_raw_news.content: Army Chief Gen Dhiraj Seth holds bilateral talks with top Russian commanders in Moscow Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर Army Chief Gen Dhiraj Seth holds bilateral talks with top Russian commanders in Moscow ANI | Updated: Sep 17, 2026 20:06 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel Moscow [Russia], September 17 (ANI): Chief of Staff of the Army General Dhiraj Seth held high-level delegation talks with top Russian military commanders to step up bilateral ground forces cooperation and discuss projects aimed at boosting the combat readiness of both armed forces, during his visit to Moscow along with the Indian delegation. According to the Russian Ministry of Defence, following the delegation's arrival, their engagements began with the laying of wreaths at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in Alexander Garden, led by Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Ground Forces Colonel General Alexander Matovnikov. The official part of the bilateral talks was held at the Main Command of the Ground Forces, where issues of military cooperation and interaction aimed at implementing projects to increase the combat readiness of the armed forces of both countries were discussed. Agreements were reached on further expanding cooperation between the ground forces in various fields, the Ministry stated. During the visit, the delegation will visit the National Defence Management Centre of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation and military educational institutions of the Ground Forces. Earlier on Wednesday, Chief of the Army Staff General Dhiraj Seth began an official three-day visit to Russia aimed at further strengthening the longstanding India-Russia defence partnership and military-to-military cooperation. According to an official release issued by the Ministry of Defence, General Seth is visiting Russia from September 16 to September 18. He will also hold discussions with Colonel General Andrei Nikolayevich Mordvichev, Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Land Forces, on issues of mutual interest, including professional military cooperation and training. The visit comes against the backdrop of longstanding military-technical cooperation between India and Russia, which has evolved from a buyer-seller relationship towards joint research, development and production of advanced defence technologies and systems. In Moscow , General Seth is scheduled to visit the National Defence Control Centre and interact with senior officials of the Russian Ministry of Defence, including Deputy Defence Minister Vasily Sergeyevich Osmakov, who handles defence industry and procurement. The engagements will provide an opportunity for both sides to exchange perspectives on contemporary military developments and explore avenues for enhancing defence cooperation, according to the release. The Army Chief will also travel to Saint Petersburg, where he is scheduled to visit the Mikhailovskaya Military Artillery Academy and interact with its leadership and faculty. The Ministry of Defence said the visit "reflects the importance attached by both countries to sustained military diplomacy and Army-to-Army engagement". The interactions are expected to further deepen military cooperation and reinforce the enduring defence relationship between India and Russia.Russia remains an important source for India's defence equipment, engines, spare parts and components. national_raw_news.content: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs aligns with countrywide rollout of Swachhata hi Sewa campaign 2026 Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs aligns with countrywide rollout of Swachhata hi Sewa campaign 2026 ANI | Updated: Sep 17, 2026 19:48 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], September 17 (ANI): The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs (MoPA) actively participated in the countrywide launch of the Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026, spanning a fortnight from September 17 to October 2. According to an official release, the initiative is being observed by every department and ministry under the Government of India, with an aim to reinforce the spirit of cleanliness, hygiene, civic responsibility and citizen participation towards realising the vision of a Swachh Bharat. To kick off the event, MoPA Secretary, Nikunj Bihari Dhal, led Ministry officials in taking the cleanliness pledge. In his opening remarks, he urged that cleanliness and hygiene should not be viewed merely as a campaign-bound activity, but as a continuous, year-round responsibility and a collective way of life. In observance of the campaign and with a view to promoting sustained awareness about cleanliness and hygiene, the Ministry has drawn up a day-to-day activity plan for the period from 18 September to 1 October 2026. The planned activities will provide opportunities for the participation of officers, officials, and Safai Mitras, thereby fostering a sense of collective ownership towards cleanliness. According to the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs, the range of activities includes cleanliness drives in office premises/corridors, awareness and sensitisation activities for school students, felicitation of Safai Mitras, awareness campaigns and citizen engagement initiatives through social media platforms and plantation activities under ‘Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam’. The Ministry will also participate in the nationwide Shramdaan initiative under the call “Ek Din, Ek Ghanta, Ek Saath” on 1st October, further reinforcing the message that cleanliness is a shared responsibility requiring collective action. Through these initiatives, the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs reaffirms its commitment to the objectives of the Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026 and to promoting a sustained culture of cleanliness, hygiene, environmental responsibility and dignity of labour. national_raw_news.title: Nation gears up for Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 - PIB
national_raw_news.content: Ministry of Jal Shakti Nation gears up for Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Union Ministers Shri C. R. Paatil, Shri Tokhan Sahu and Shri V. Somanna call for nationwide participation in Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 SHS 2026 campaign places students and youth at the heart of sustained behaviour change for Swachhata ‘Swachhata Mein Sahbhag; Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat’ announced as the theme of SHS 2026 Posted On: 16 SEP 2026 9:57PM by PIB Delhi Union Minister of Jal Shakti, Shri C. R. Patil, Union Minister of State for Housing and Urban Affairs, Shri Tokhan Sahu addressed a curtain-raiser media interaction for Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 at the National Media Centre in New Delhi today. Observed annually since 2017, Swachhata Hi Seva 2026, beginning from 17 th September this year, brings citizens, institutions and leadership together to strengthen voluntarism and collective action for Swachhata. The SHS 2026 theme, ‘ Swachhata Mein Sahbhag; Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat’ , underlines that Swachhata is a shared responsibility and that the vision of a Swachh and Viksit Bharat can be realized only through the active participation of all citizens. The national curtain-raiser event/ interaction was held ahead of the nationwide campaign beginning tomorrow. Jointly organized by the Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation (DDWS), Ministry of Jal Shakti and Department of Urban Development (DoUD) Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, SHS 2026 will bring together Central Ministries and Departments, States/UTs Rural and Urban local bodies, institutions and other stakeholders for collective action for Swachhata. Speaking on the occasion, Union Minister of Jal Shakti, Shri C R Patil, underscored that, under the visionary leadership of the Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, Swachhata has evolved into a national movement driven by Jan Bhagidari. He noted that the Hon’ble Prime Minister has consistently led this movement from the front and inspired citizens across the country. Emphasizing that cleanliness is a shared responsibility, he called upon every citizen, particularly students and youth, to participate wholeheartedly in SHS 2026 and strengthen the collective resolve for a Swachh Bharat and Viksit Bharat. The Minister cited the example of Navsari’s ‘Swachhata Se Swagat’- Micro Swachhata Abhiyaan before the visit of Hon’ble Prime Minister, where people from all walks of life came together for micro cleaning in villages. He also referred to the example of Surat for prompt cleaning after Visarjan of Ganpati last year and people coming together for support, recognition and felicitation of sanitation workers. He mentioned that people are now increasingly coming out to participate and contribute to Swachhata which is the awareness and behaviour change brought about by the Hon’ble Prime Minister in the country. In a virtual message, Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs, Shri Manohar Lal, called upon States to ensure enthusiastic participation in the upcoming Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 campaign. He requested that citizens begin the campaign by cleaning their own homes on 17 th September. national_raw_news.title: Modi turns 76: Same ad, five papers, and the advertorial that wasn't labelled one
national_raw_news.content: Modi turns 76: Same ad, five papers, and the advertorial that wasn’t labelled one Shot Modi turns 76: Same ad, five papers, and the advertorial that wasn’t labelled one A reading of Thursday’s tributes, jacket ads and advertorials in major newspapers marking the prime minister’s 76th birthday Written By: NL Team Date: 17 Sep, 2026 Read in app Narendra Modi turns 76 today, and the machinery around the occasion, including the Union government, a clutch of BJP-run states, and the party organisation, has already lined up a month’s worth of events. Thursday’s newspapers got the opening act: front pages replaced by paid jacket advertisements, wishing the prime minister well before a single news story got a look-in. The most travelled of these jackets was not sold by any company. It was a Shiv Sena tribute titled “India's Pride: A conscientious Prime Minister”, showing Modi in prayer pose, crediting him as “the longest-serving Prime Minister of India elected by people” and recipient of “highest civilian awards of 36 nations,” signed off by Maharashtra deputy CM Eknath Shinde. It ran as the front-page jacket on Hindustan Times , Dainik Bhaska r, Dainik Jagran, Amar Ujala and The Times of India . The Indian Express skipped the recycled portrait and went for volume instead. There were at least four separate advertorials in its Delhi edition, each dutifully labelled “Advertorial” in small print. The standalone wraparound came from Ashok Singh Jaunapuria, a “BJP Karyakarta” from Sohna, Haryana: “HAPPY BIRTHDAY to the leader who puts Bharat above all,” backed by a scorecard – 57-plus crore Jan Dhan beneficiaries, “4th largest economy,” 2.3 lakh-plus DPIIT-recognised startups, “7x growth” in electronics. Each statistic was footnoted to PMJDY/PIB, DPIIT/PIB, MeitY/PIB and the IMF's 2025 World Economic Outlook. It was a government press-release fact sheet dressed up as a well-wisher’s note. Elsewhere in the edition, Kalra Hospital paired “Birthday Greetings” with a promotional interview about its own 50-year history and cardiology credentials; Delhi Book Store’s managing director used his greeting to segue into a company profile, congratulating Modi on “the success of Brics Summit 2026” along the way; and TDI Group combined “Warmest Birthday Wishes” with a pitch for a township with “43 acres of green spaces,” and a separate advertorial titled “The Modi Blueprint: Decades of Governance and the Path to 2047.” Hindustan Times carried the Shinde jacket up front, then the Uttar Pradesh government’s “Seva Sankalp Abhiyan” further in that took note of “25 years of dedicated public service” above the image of Yogi Adityanath, bundled with a Varanasi sanitation-workers’ felicitation and a bike yatra to Vadnagar, with a full roster of BJP and allied leaders listed underneath. Two Union government ads and a Delhi government ad round out the edition, neither framed as birthday wishes but both leaning on Modi’s image. The Times of India buried its own front page behind two Samsung ad wraps before readers reached the Shinde tribute at all. Further in: the UP government’s ad again, and a Finolex Pipes & Fittings...

national_raw_news.title: Kashmir media delegation calls on LG Puducherry during tour
national_raw_news.content: Kashmir media delegation calls on LG Puducherry during tour Advertisment Breaking News Kashmir Kashmir media delegation calls on LG Puducherry during tour RK News 17 Sep 2026 08:24 IST Follow Us Puducherry, Sep 16: A media delegation from Kashmir on a five-day exposure tour to Chennai organised by Press Information Bureau (PIB) on Wednesday called on Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry, Kuniyil Kailashnathan, at Lok Niwas, Puducherry. During an hour-long interaction, Kailashnathan reflected on his long administrative career and also shared his vision and roadmap for the development of Puducherry. The LG said that he envisions transforming the Union Territory into a major medical tourism hub. As informed, Puducherry with a population of only fifteen lakhs currently has seven medical colleges including the prestigious Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) an institution of national importance. The delegation was informed that work is ongoing to expand the runway of the airport to 2500 meters from the present 1500 meters to support larger commercial aircrafts which will boost direct air connectivity and is expected to increase the tourist inflow. In addition to this, works for railway and roadways expansion are also expected to be completed by 2028. While discussing the industrial developmental scenario in Kashmir, the LG opined that the government of Jammu and Kashmir needs to offer various sops to attract industrial investment ranging from tax holidays to cheap power in addition to further improvements in the transportation infrastructure which has to a larger extent improved with the railway connectivity with the rest of the country. The meeting provided an opportunity for the visiting journalists to gain insights into the administration and development initiatives in Puducherry. The delegation is on a press tour to Chennai from September 13 to 19, organised by PIB Srinagar. As part of the tour, the delegation is visiting various institutions and projects in Chennai to meet the senior officials and beneficiaries. Later in the day, the delegation also visited Auroville Foundation - an experimental spiritual township and interacted with the residents and the members. The delegation is visiting different institutions and infrastructure projects in Chennai to witness first-hand the developmental journey for Viksit Bharat 2047 and also document the impact of various public welfare schemes at the grassroots level. Daily Excelsior 04:23 AM Sep 17, 2026 IST Officials during a ‘Vartalap’ programme organised by the PIB, Srinagar in collaboration with NCB, in Srinagar on Wednesday. -Excelsior/Shakeel ‘Youth key to Nasha Mukt Bharat campaign’ Excelsior Correspondent SRINAGAR, Sept 16: The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) today said it was shifting its anti-drug strategy from a seizure-centric approach to a network-centric model focused on dismantling trafficking networks, choking their financial channels and disrupting the infrastructure supporting the drug trade. Advertisement NCB Zonal Director for J&K and Ladakh Piyush Kumar Ankit said the shift was part of the Vision Document on Narcotics Control 2026-29. He was speaking to reporters on the sidelines of a 'Vartalap' programme organised by the Press Information Bureau (PIB), Srinagar, in collaboration with the NCB to create awareness about the document. The 'Vartalap' was conducted by Ankit, PIB Srinagar Director Qazi Salman and Assistant Director (Media), Ministry of Home Affairs, Rajeev Kumar Rustagi. It aimed to familiarise media persons and other stakeholders with the Vision Document and encourage wider public participation in the 'Nasha Mukt Bharat' campaign. "We are moving towards a network-centric approach rather than a mere seizure-centric approach," Ankit said, stressing that drug trafficking had to be tackled at both the network and financial levels. The three-year roadmap, running from July 2026 to July 2029, seeks to make India "drug-free" by 2029 and is built around four pillars, intelligence and operation-based enforcement, precursor and synthetic drug control, demand and harm reduction, and capacity building and coordination. Ankit said enforcement agencies were putting in place coordinated, real-time mechanisms to strengthen the supply-side response and enable quicker action against trafficking networks. Ankit said Vision Document was prepared through a "whole-of-Government" and "whole-of-society" approach following consultations with Central Government ministries, departments, drug law enforcement agencies and other stakeholders. The roadmap combines supply reduction with measures to curb demand and harm, with greater emphasis on synthetic drugs, darknet-enabled trafficking, drug-financing networks and fugitives. "Enforcement can reduce the supply, but demand reduction requires awareness across society," Ankit said, stressing that public participation was essential to the anti-drug campaign. The 'Nasha Mukt Bharat' campaign will focus particularly on young people, with educational institutions being brought into efforts to create drug-free campuses. Platforms including NCC, NSS and My Bharat will also be used to create 'Nasha Mukt Bharat Mitras'. "Youth are an important stakeholder in taking this message forward," Ankit said, calling for greater awareness of the Vision Document among young people. The programme also highlighted national enforcement achievements in drug seizures, arrests, deep-level investigations and destruction of seized narcotics. Referring...

national_raw_news.content: From Maritime Smuggling to Darknet Networks, PIB, NCB & MHA Jointly Briefs Media in Srinagar - https://onlykashmir.in/ Facebook Instagram Pinterest X Website Youtube State National World Watch Feature Columns Corner Urdu Behind The News Satire Entertainment Sports Videos About Us Search Only Kashmir Behind The News Facebook Instagram X Only Kashmir Behind The News State National World Watch Feature Columns Corner Urdu Behind The News Satire Entertainment Sports Videos About Us Search Home Spotlight Spotlight State From Maritime Smuggling to Darknet Networks, PIB, NCB & MHA Jointly Briefs Media in Srinagar By Online Editor September 17, 2026 Advertisement CM Inaugurates Renovated J&K House Amritsar September 17, 2026 LG Sinha Launches Seva Sankalp Abhiyan September 17, 2026 From Maritime Smuggling to Darknet Networks, PIB, NCB & MHA Jointly Briefs Media in Srinagar September 17, 2026 Govt Sets Deadlines for PM Package Flats September 17, 2026 Kashmir University Inter-Department Sports Tournaments Conclude September 17, 2026 Advertisement - Advertisement - Bilal Bashir Bhat onlykashmir News Desk Srinagar, Sep 16: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Srinagar, in collaboration with the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), organised a ‘Vartalap’ programme in Srinagar to sensitise media representatives about the Nasha Mukt Bharat Vision Document 2026–2029 and the government’s roadmap to combat drug trafficking and abuse. The session highlighted the three-year national roadmap, which focuses on intelligence and enforcement, control of precursor and synthetic drugs, demand and harm reduction, and capacity building and coordination, with the objective of making India drug-free by 2029. NCB Zonal Director Piyush Kumar Ankit, PIB Srinagar Director Qazi Salman and Assistant Director (Media), Ministry of Home Affairs, Rajeev Kumar Rustagi, interacted with media representatives and explained key components of the vision document. The presentation highlighted an expansion of the NCB’s institutional capacity. Its manpower has increased from 1,107 to 1,630, while zonal units have risen from 13 to 36 and regional offices from 3 to 7. Since 2019, properties and assets worth ₹3,992 crore have been frozen or seized, while 128 illegal clandestine laboratories were dismantled between 2019 and July 2026. The programme also highlighted an increase in the conviction rate from 60.5 per cent in 2024 to 65.5 per cent in 2025 and 68.6 per cent in Q1 2026. There are currently 176 Special NDPS Courts, while during Q1 2026, 73 offenders were convicted in 35 cases, with four sentenced to a maximum of 20 years of rigorous imprisonment. Major Operations Highlighted The NCB presentation also detailed several major operations targeting organised drug-trafficking networks. Under Operation Sagar Manthan, a joint maritime operation involving the NCB, Indian Navy, Coast Guard and Gujarat ATS resulted in the seizure of approximately 3,400 kg of narcotics and the arrest of 25 foreign nationals. Other operations highlighted included: Operation Crystal Fortress: Seizure of 328.54 kg of methamphetamine linked to an international syndicate. Operation Ragepill: Seizure of 227.7 kg of Captagon, described as the first-ever seizure of the drug in India. Operation White Strike: Seizure of 349 kg of high-grade cocaine, with an estimated value of ₹1,745 crore....
